bio: B.Tech Computer Science student (RBMI Group of Institutions, AKTU), graduating September 2027, with hands-on internship experience building social platform and marketplace products at SuperX Corporation, Noida. Core stack is MERN (React.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB) and Python, layered with an AI/agentic engineering toolkit spanning Claude/Anthropic APIs, LangGraph, MCP (Model Context Protocol), OpenAI API, and Gemini AI. Focused on shipping real, usable products, from full-stack web apps to autonomous AI agents.
